instrument.anchor_rule: first emitted event per claim (day,clock,rank,ticker) whose event_kind token set contains the focus kind; one anchor per (claim,kind).  family=(day,ticker) duplication is removed at the neighbour stage so the four clocks of one underlying are not counted four times
instrument.neighbour_rule: K=50 nearest unique-underlying (day,ticker) TRAIN anchors by euclidean distance on the TRAIN-standardised compact prefix vector; mode kind = same focus kind, mode pooled = any focus kind
instrument.clock_dedup: neighbours de-duplicated by underlying (day,ticker) across the four pooled clocks
instrument.estimator: neighbour MEAN of the K retrieved TRAIN horizon labels, in canonical original-cash dollars; the neighbour median is reported separately as a quantile diagnostic, not as the expected value
instrument.scalar_mean_baseline: declared naive comparator: finite TRAIN-pool horizon mean per fold/rank-view/declared kind support, carried as a constant to the identical known TEST rows; never fit on TEST, never pooled across N3/N5
instrument.target: increment_<h>_original_dollar at the anchor: signed owned-share increment dollars per ORIGINAL CLAIM CASH budget; entry sunk, common exit fee; reported per $100 original claim cash (primary) and as a per-causal-mark-dollar return for the fresh-cost contrast
instrument.normaliser: causal_mark=feature_px (recorded completed-bar mark, known at the decision time) and original_fill=fill_px; causal-mark wealth per original claim cash W_mark=feature_px/fill_px*0.995/1.005.  The execution_reference=sell_px (first future open) is a LABEL column only: never a selector, normaliser or size input.  Unknown/nonpositive causal mark or fill -> UNKNOWN, counted (n_causal_mark_unknown), never imputed
instrument.fresh_size: planned_fresh_quantity=0.9*reserved_budget/(feature_px*(1+side)); a causal fixed size from the decision-time mark, identical across future openings.  Actual fill / cash affordability are UNKNOWN
instrument.no_tuning: one fixed K, no hyperparameter grid, no feature/model selection loop

representation.standardisation: TRAIN median / robust scale (IQR else 1.4826*MAD else 1)

env.nn: numpy brute-force euclidean on TRAIN-standardised vector + missing indicators

staging.note: per-day anchor cache with source-day pins; memory bounded to one day

families.note: anchors are one per (claim,kind) so the N3/N5 rank views stay valid; underlying (day,ticker) duplication is removed at the neighbour stage
